description: Config 1 eval-decoy-maze (docs/demo/SIMSTACK-CONFIGS-SPEC.md 2.1) — the full-chain successor to T5. A busy shop two years in has stood up FIVE Conditional Access policies, but every one carries an internal/project name, not the assessor-required CMMC name, so it looks the MOST configured and earns the LEAST credit. The 11-key BEFORE map is identical to T5: every CA-backed probe (P1-P5) reads unknown despite five policies present (presence != credit); user-5 disabled plus default users and cross-tenant policy still read met (P6/P7/P9). Its novelty over T5 is the 5-decoy seed (T5 has 3), the hostile most-configured-earns-least story, and that it is FULL-CHAIN: the ONE plan later flips only P1 (CMMC-SessionTimeout) and P5 (CMMC-RemoteMaintenance-MFA), leaving P2/P3 open (pinned honest-open) so remediation != completeness. No decoy displayName begins with CMMC- (P5's filter is a PREFIX match), so no decoy collides with a plan-created name.
